upstream_commits.body_normalized:
Prevent dialog from hanging when `getValue()` throws (#18938)

## Summary

Fixes #12863

When a dialog body widget's `getValue()` method throws an error, the
dialog's `_resolve` method would crash without disposing the dialog or
resolving/rejecting the promise. This caused the dialog to hang
indefinitely, requiring a browser refresh.

## Changes

- Modified `packages/apputils/src/dialog.tsx`:
  - Added try-catch around `body.getValue()` call in `_resolve()`
- If `getValue()` throws, the dialog is properly disposed and the
promise is rejected
- Added a unit test in `packages/apputils/test/dialog.spec.tsx` that
verifies the promise is rejected when `getValue()` throws

## Other PRs targeting this issue

There is another PR targeting this issue: #18345 by @GlobalStar117. That
PR was opened in January 2026 and has had no activity since March. Our
PR is based on the latest `main` branch and includes a unit test. The
code change is identical in approach (try-catch around `getValue()`), as
there is essentially only one correct way to fix this issue. We believe
this PR should be preferred because it is up-to-date and includes test
coverage.

## LLM Usage Disclosure

This PR was developed with assistance from an AI coding assistant
(Claude). The AI helped identify the bug, write the fix, and draft the
unit test. All changes were reviewed before committing.

## References

- Original issue: #12863
- Related PR: #18345

---

### Testing

A unit test was added to `packages/apputils/test/dialog.spec.tsx` that
creates a widget body whose `getValue()` method throws, launches a
dialog, clicks accept, and verifies the promise is rejected with the
expected error.

All 51 tests in the dialog test suite pass (50 existing + 1 new), and
linting passes with no errors.

To run the test:
```bash
jlpm test packages/apputils -t "should reject the promise when getValue() throws"
```
